description: Spec workflow guard: workflow state (records, archive and toolkit manifests, assignment markers) is CLI-only; specs are created and edited only by spec.py (new/edit) and accepted specs are frozen; subagents cannot edit specs/ (drafts go to specs/.drafts/) or run spec-mutating commands; the plugin cache is never written; subagents write only inside their lane assignment; advisory: spec-workflow subagent prompts should be a verbatim `spec-tracker brief`
